prompt:

Leave TWO SECONDS OF COMPLETE SILENCE between terms so learners can repeat each one. No introductions, labels, numbering, definitions, commentary, music, or sound effects. Do not pronounce punctuation.
Silent pronunciation reference, DO NOT READ:

day off: a day when you do not have to work

Wi-Fi: a wireless connection to the internet
ZIP code: a number code for an area
apartment number: the unit number in a building
tracking number: a code used to find a package
forward mail: send mail from an old address to a new one

READ ONLY THESE TERMS, WITH SILENT GAPS:
